mentions.name: Steno
mentions.description: A single-download app for recording meetings and transcribing audio into meeting minutes using only local LLMs, so recordings and data never touch the cloud; runs on macOS (tested), Windows (not yet tested), and Linux (tested on ChromeOS/Terminal).
mentions.problem: Recording a small multi-person in-person meeting and producing good meeting notes in Norwegian is tricky, especially using only local LLMs while keeping the data from ever touching the cloud.
mentions.source_excerpt:
But I have a wip single download app that lets one record and transcribe - should work on MacOS (tested), Windows (not yet tested), Linux (tested on chromeOS/Terminal).

The UI is a vibecoded mess:

https://hypertekst.net/steno/
mentions.author: e12e
